Tides
Tide tables explained

By Ada Fenwick

A tide table lists the predicted times and heights of high and low water for one place. Read the date first, then the height.

The gauge at the old pier.
Reading a row
Tomorrow at the pier
Time	Height	State
04:12	0.6 m	Low
10:31	4.1 m	High
